paragraphs: Rava bar Mesharshiya spoke to Rava: Nazir 40b. There is a Rav Mesharshiya bar Rava—that is, Rava bar Yosef—so Rava bar Mesharshiya spoke to his grandfather Rava. This needs examination, because he spoke to Rava about the objection Rava of Barnish raised to Rav Ashi; Rava preceded Rav Ashi by much, since Rav Ashi was born on the day Rava died.
